plugins.name: Voice typing
plugins.description: Convert Persian speech to text offline.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.attribution: Shenava Koochik v1.5 RNNT sherpa-onnx model; upstream revision c46e9af380770a07509a3591169c99e936e0cc96

plugins.release_notes: Experimental offline Persian RNNT model. Sherpa-ONNX nemo_transducer. Upstream revision c46e9af380770a07509a3591169c99e936e0cc96; author-reported Golden-6669 WER 9.50% / CER 2.60%. Not yet independently benchmarked on Link devices.

plugins.name: Document Editor
plugins.description: Persian and English image-to-text OCR, automatic document scanning, PDF and editable Word export, and QR/barcode reading in one optional capability.

license.name: Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, libpng and IJG
license.attribution: Tesseract OCR 5.5.1, Tesseract4Android 4.9.0, tessdata_fast Persian/English models, Google ML Kit Document Scanner and Google Code Scanner. Leptonica retains its BSD-2-Clause notice.

plugins.release_notes: Fix isolated ML Kit initialization by using the documented public MlKit.initialize API for document scanning and QR/barcode scanning; surface the underlying initialization error if it fails.

plugins.name: Magic Touch Photo
plugins.description: Draw a green Keep+ lasso to preserve its selected area, or a red Keep- lasso to remove its selected area.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.attribution: MediaPipe Tasks Vision and MagicTouch model by Google

plugins.release_notes: Repackages the reviewed lasso-based Keep+ and Keep- runtime with its pinned MediaPipe native dependency set. Keep+ preserves the selected area; Keep- removes the selected area while preserving the rest.

plugins.description: Detects language, reads English text from images with on-demand ML Kit OCR, and translates on-device with managed offline language models.

license.attribution: Google ML Kit Translation, Language Identification, and Text Recognition APIs
license.name: Apache-2.0

plugins.name: Smart Translate
plugins.release_notes: Fixes plugin-local ML Kit vision runtime packaging for the Text Recognition Detector API. The OCR model is delivered on demand by Google Play services and is not packaged in the Link APK. Existing bundled Language ID and user-managed translation models are unchanged.

plugins.name: Read text
